# Zoth Studio v2

> Zoth Studio v2 is a local-first multi-agent development studio engineered by NullAI Tech. It unifies 21 autonomous agents across 5 operational cadres, local model foundries, WebGPU WASM acceleration, and biomorphic Spike-Timing-Dependent Plasticity (STDP) synaptic memory designed to run on your own machine.

Canonical URL: https://zoth.nullai.tech
Codebase: https://github.com/NullAITech/zoth-studio-v2
Publisher: NullAI Tech (https://nullai.tech)
npm CLI: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@nullaitech/zoth

## Quickstart (npm CLI)

- `npx @nullaitech/zoth status`: Check which local Zoth services are running.
- `npx @nullaitech/zoth list`: List the 79 public Zoth tool repos (of 80 total in Zoth Studio).
- `npx @nullaitech/zoth pull <tool>`: Download a Zoth tool repo.
- `npx @nullaitech/zoth studio`: Install and launch Zoth Studio locally on http://localhost:3000.
- ZOTHOS (the Linux distro with 75+ curated tools): https://github.com/NullAITech/zoth-os

## Core Hubs & Consoles

- [Sovereign Hub](https://zoth.nullai.tech/): Primary mission control, zero-egress architecture overview, and quickstart commands.
- [Lucy Netrunner Memory Hub](https://zoth.nullai.tech/memory): Biomorphic STDP synaptic associative memory matrix, real-time waveform visualizer, and SQLite vector strata.
- [21 Swarm Pantheon](https://zoth.nullai.tech/swarm): Autonomous multi-agent coordination across Architects, Code, Security, Creative, and Swarm cadres.
- [Byzantine Consensus Arena](https://zoth.nullai.tech/consensus): Triadic AST diff arbitration and cryptographic 2/3 quorum verification.
- [Autonomous WebGen](https://zoth.nullai.tech/webgen): Deterministic zero-cloud website generator and layout synthesizer with 6 architectural archetypes.
- [HexStrike Cybersec Terminal](https://zoth.nullai.tech/hexstrike): Local CVE vulnerability matrix, attack surface analyzer, and exploit audit lab.
- [Zoth OS Kernel](https://zoth.nullai.tech/zoth-os): Local Linux KVM hypervisor sandbox, thin QEMU disk management, and WebContainer runtime.
- [Adytum Sanctum](https://zoth.nullai.tech/adytum): 22 Hermetic key engineering lifecycle, 5-minute incubation gates, and Argon2id hardware key vault.
- [Sovereign Arsenal](https://zoth.nullai.tech/arsenal): Comprehensive searchable directory of all 43 workstations, 80 Studio tools (56 in-browser/WebGPU + 24 CLI/daemon, 79 public GitHub repos), and 21 autonomous Studio Pantheon agents.
- [Micro-Tools Registry](https://zoth.nullai.tech/tools): Schema-validated in-browser developer utilities for JWT verification, payload entropy, and code export.
- [Workstations Matrix](https://zoth.nullai.tech/workstations): 43 interactive studio environments spanning Build, Security, Swarm, Spatial, and Observe bands.
- [Enclave Bridges](https://zoth.nullai.tech/bridges): End-to-end encrypted inter-agent signal mesh and local IPC bus monitor.

## Formal Mathematical Pillars

- [Six Mathematical Pillars](https://zoth.nullai.tech/docs/math): Formal mathematical foundations governing attention, loss landscapes, dynamical systems, and STDP.
- [Pillar I: Linear Algebra](https://zoth.nullai.tech/docs/math/linear): Attention mechanisms, projection tensors, and scaled dot-product matrices.
- [Pillar II: Multivariable Calculus](https://zoth.nullai.tech/docs/math/calculus): Non-convex gradient descent, AdamW momentum, and loss manifolds.
- [Pillar III: Probability & Information](https://zoth.nullai.tech/docs/math/probability): Shannon entropy, sampling temperature dynamics, and token logit distributions.
- [Pillar IV: Loss Landscapes & Hessian](https://zoth.nullai.tech/docs/math/hessian): Curvature eigenspaces, Hessian condition numbers, and saddle-point escape dynamics.
- [Pillar V: Dynamical Systems & Lyapunov](https://zoth.nullai.tech/docs/math/lyapunov): Phase space attractors, Hamiltonian orbits, and Lyapunov stability proofs.
- [Pillar VI: Neuromorphic STDP](https://zoth.nullai.tech/docs/math/stdp): Exponential Spike-Timing-Dependent Plasticity proofs and biomorphic synaptic weight adaptation.
